Placing Presidential records in the Presidential Library blocks FOIA access for a certain number of years, thus preventing ordinary citizens from accessing them. Obama has famously blocked FOIA access from more of his old records than any previous President. But court subpoenas work in this situation in the same way they would work in any other.
